verdict.rationale: Bun ships an extensive, well-documented official CLI (install, add, remove, update, pm, workspaces, audit, etc.) covering the entire package-manager workflow, and the site exposes an llms.txt / docs.md endpoint specifically structured for AI/agent consumption, signaling first-class support for AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: no explicit agent-oriented features like structured JSON output flags or documented agent integration guides beyond the llms.txt discovery.
